reasoning_traces.think:
The primitives define a hierarchical model where coverage type classification determines receiver performance potential, which is then refined by matchup favorability and expected shell outcomes. The system operates under a dual logic: first, identifying defensive structure (man vs zone) via coverage grades; second, assessing receiver fit through percentile rankings and historical trends. This enables a Bayesian update on expected outcomes, where prior beliefs about performance are adjusted based on observed defensive tendencies. The failure mode occurs when defensive alignment shifts unpredictably or when receiver performance deviates from historical norms due to injury or coaching changes. The isomorphism between coverage type and performance allows for cross-layer validation of predictions across multiple weeks and opponents.
